definitions.gloss: resourcefulness; quick wit; talent for practical problem-solving
definitions.explanation: The ability to think quickly and find clever solutions, especially in practical or business matters. Implies a combination of intelligence and pragmatic adaptability.

definitions.gloss: means of raising money; financial resourcefulness
definitions.explanation: The ability to procure money or resources when needed, often through clever or industrious means.

examples.japanese: {商売|しょうばい}の{才覚|さいかく}がある。
examples.english: To have a talent for business.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{才覚|さいかく}のある{人|ひと}で、どんな{困難|こんなん}も{乗|の}り{越|こ}えてきた。
examples.english: She is a resourceful person who has overcome every difficulty.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{才覚|さいかく}で{小|ちい}さな{店|みせ}を{大企業|だいきぎょう}に{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: With his innate resourcefulness, he grew a small shop into a large corporation.

examples.japanese: {資金|しきん}の{才覚|さいかく}がつかない。
examples.english: I can't find a way to raise the funds.

examples.japanese: どこからか{金|かね}の{才覚|さいかく}をつけてくる。
examples.english: To find a way to come up with money from somewhere.

examples.japanese: {開業|かいぎょう}に{必要|ひつよう}な{資金|しきん}の{才覚|さいかく}に{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: I struggled to find ways to raise the funds needed to open the business.

notes:
Combines {才|さい} (talent) with {覚|かく} (perception/awareness). Emphasizes practical, street-smart intelligence rather than academic brilliance. Historically associated with merchant culture in the Edo period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {才覚|さいかく}がある: to be resourceful
- {才覚|さいかく}のある{人|ひと}: a resourceful person
- {商売|しょうばい}の{才覚|さいかく}: business acumen
- {金|かね}の{才覚|さいかく}をつける: to find a way to raise money
- {資金|しきん}の{才覚|さいかく}: means of procuring funds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {才能|さいのう}: talent; ability — more general, can refer to any kind of talent including artistic or academic. {才覚|さいかく} specifically implies practical cleverness.
- {機転|きてん}: quick thinking; tact — focuses on responding well in the moment, while {才覚|さいかく} implies a broader, enduring quality.
- {知恵|ちえ}: wisdom; resourcefulness — warmer and more everyday; {才覚|さいかく} has a slightly more formal, literary tone.
